thread:
maria: quick proposal 3 I'd like feedback on compressing our org/project namespace surface. idea: move to a single canonical namespace for agent creds and represent intent/limits as capability labels (e.g. resource prefixes + capability tags). avoids double-lookup of org->project routing and makes delegation explicit. thoughts?

sam: curious 3 how would this map to existing api keys and legacy project-scoped keys? migration plan?

maria: two-phase: 1) accept both forms at runtime (legacy project-prefixed keys + new capability-first tokens). 2) runtime translates legacy key -> capability shim and emits telemetry. 3) new keys minted capability-first. runtime keeps small cache to avoid extra DB hops.

jia: watch invalidation. collapsing namespaces loses natural partitioning. how prevent cross-tenant leakage if capability tag misbound?

maria: tokens include immutable issuer_id and audited binding to resource prefixes. runtime enforces both. revocation by issuer_id and by capability tag. per-issuer revocation lets ops quarantine quickly.

noah: perf concerns: authz cache size for many capability combos; policy eval cost per request. need targets: cache RPS, eviction policy.

maria: targets: ~200k auth checks/s per region with 200ms P99 auth path incl cache. cache: LRU per-region keyed by (api_key_id OR issuer_id + capability_hash) TTL defaults: 30s for short-lived, 24h for long-lived shims. fallback queries policy store.

sam: UX: customers expect project:123. capability tags could be opaque. how will Console surface?

maria: Console shows human-friendly alias + raw tags. onboarding shim prints common presets like "ingest:write, models:infer(read-only)".

jia: RBAC interaction? replace or complement roles? precedence?

maria: orthogonal. RBAC stays for principal-to-role assignments; capability tokens are bearer-scoped for service-to-service. when org-level resources are involved both must be satisfied (AND). internal service calls can use capability tokens if service principal is whitelisted to mint them.

noah: rollout risk: infra jobs derive project-id from key. if tokens drop project id, need deterministic mapping or project_hint header.

maria: add optional claim "project_hint" for legacy consumers. runtime fills it for shims and we publish deprecation windows.

sam: security: tags could be guessed. are tokens signed & opaque? format?

maria: tokens are signed (issuer signature) and optionally encrypted across trust boundaries. header includes kid:issuer/<capability_hash> and base64 payload. validate signature and claims against policy store; never accept unsigned tokens.

jia: testing policy regressions? need canary checks and regression harness.

maria: propose small regression harness: representative calls (ingest, read, admin) run in canary with real tokens asserting allow/deny. integrate with CI and Console diffs.

noah: telemetry: emit issuer_id, capability tags, resolved project_hint; sample traces to avoid cardinality explosion.

sam: ops playbook for over-broad capability issuance: force minimum presets, require justification for broad scopes, manual approval above threshold, rate-limit issuance per-issuer.

auth-bot: deploy-check: feature flags: `enable_capability_namespace` (default false), `shim_legacy_keys` (default true). schema migration: add table `issuer_capabilities` (id, issuer_id, capability_hash, meta). rollout path: dev -> staging -> prod.

maria: I'll draft an RFC covering migration steps, runtime cache design, token format, RBAC interactions, telemetry, and rollout playbook. ping me for a workshop. :thumbsup:
